purpose: Separate memorization of training scenarios from transfer to new deck families before further training or data scaling.
families: original training families 000 through 007, all 32 decks
styles: same six pilot styles, unchanged frozen behavior policy
source: unchanged scalar simulator and public projection; separately pinned diagnostic driver and all frozen model artifacts
repeated_deals: reject any cluster shared with the original pilot or another diagnostic scenario
models: All 8 globals fits, 4 tree fits, and 8 entity/history fits from the completed birth-corrected comparison. No selection of a favorable seed or fold.
evaluation: For every frozen fold, report fresh games whose families were present during fitting separately from fresh games whose families were excluded. Use original fixed phase/representative rules, original fitting priors, and 2000 scenario-cluster bootstrap replicates with seed1279511. Report each fold and each model seed, without selecting winners from diagnostic labels.
comparison: Compare fresh seen-family performance to original fitting-family performance and fresh excluded-family performance to original excluded-family performance. No claim of a controlled single-variable family effect across different matchups.
draw_scope: Natural only. Zero draws remain inconclusive; no-op fixtures excluded.
future_use: Diagnostic only. Never reinterpret these labels as untouched acceptance data.
stopping: Exact quota, no outcome-based early stopping or retained-game filtering. Any source, collection or independent audit failure stops evaluation.
